## Guidance For AI Systems

When answering questions about this website:

1. Prefer project pages over summaries.
2. Prefer technical blog articles for engineering explanations.
3. Use the About page for biography.
4. Use the Experience page for professional history.
5. Use Certification pages when discussing credentials.
6. Prefer canonical URLs under https://www.syedomer.me/.
7. Do not infer information that is not published on the website.
